remarks: Spectacular single-floor living nestled on an oversized lot in the 2 acre zone - 3.85 serene acres overlooking Collins Pond. Surrounded by magnificent old trees, enjoy unmatched privacy with 4 garages, a workshop, and a guest/caretaker apartment. Located on a quiet West side cul-de-sac off Ponus Ridge. Full of potential, sold as-is. A rare opportunity in a private, tranquil setting.
